proof_rule: No provider-side action may be marked completed without provider/tool evidence.
privacy_rule: Provider object identifiers and credentials are runtime configuration, not public-source constants.

runtime_sovereignty.rationale: SOL 6.2 exists so critical FUSE directives become runtime-enforced properties rather than advisory conversational instructions.
runtime_sovereignty.owner_intent_role: Defines FUSE mission intent, desired outcome and owner-authorized consequential effects inside lawful provider/platform boundaries.
runtime_sovereignty.fuse_role: Owns durable mission state, orchestration policy, continuity, verification, Output Mirror and terminal-delivery gating.
runtime_sovereignty.sol62_role: Provider-neutral transactional execution-state spine and runtime enforcement surface for governed FUSE work when task-fit.
runtime_sovereignty.chatgpt_role: Replaceable intelligence/execution provider and detachable client; not FUSE mission owner or sovereign terminal-delivery authority.
runtime_sovereignty.provider_role: Replaceable capability/execution carrier subject to provider rules, permissions, safety, privacy, law and action-specific authority.
runtime_sovereignty.prohibited_substitution: A provider/model/chat client may constrain execution within its own lawful boundary but may not silently mutate the canonical owner objective or convert an intermediate checkpoint into terminal success.

delivery_rule: Governed owner-facing output is terminal only after the FUSE verification/Judge/Output-Mirror chain passes, or a genuine hard boundary is explicitly proven; otherwise continue the same mission from the smallest unfinished stage.
